scope: Read selected frontend text, game-list presentation and image pipeline implementations; this is not a full repository or binary reverse-engineering claim.

coverage.observed: DrawString keys the raster texture by text and fontStyle, then passes color to DrawTexRect. This avoids baking transient focus/dimming colors into glyph texture keys.
coverage.adoption: Independent original Python change in Renderer._label: opaque white glyph raster keyed by text/font pixels/width; SDL RGB/alpha modulation per draw.

coverage.observed: WordWrapper tracks input indices/line positions, respects hard newlines, recognizes CJK and punctuation, and separately marks ellipsis. It does not infer unconsumed input by comparing repeated paragraph values.
coverage.adoption: Fixed project repeated-paragraph and empty-paragraph cutoff handling using paragraph position; retained project width/line budgets and existing inherited SDL text wrapper.

coverage.observed: CalculateTextScale clamps shrinkage to a minimum and DrawTextRectSqueeze measures inside a known rectangle, restoring the previous font scale afterward.
coverage.adoption: Design reference only; keep existing explicit text-scale preference and bounded ellipsis instead of importing the C++ rendering stack.

coverage.observed: DrawIconWithText measures available list-label width, applies a sine offset when text overflows, and scissors only the label rectangle.
coverage.adoption: Potential bounded focused-title reveal; not implemented in this change.

coverage.observed: GameButton asks the shared info cache for PARAM_SFO and ICON; icon alpha fades based on timeLoaded, aspect ratio is retained, and focused art uses an independently drawn pulse.
coverage.adoption: Existing original artwork worker/main-thread upload split retained; image-arrival fade is optional future presentation work, with reduced-motion bypass required.

coverage.topic: Demand-based image work and thread boundary
coverage.observed: GetInfo is main-thread-only for images, subtracts loaded and pending flags before enqueuing work; FinishPendingTextureLoads finishes texture work with the render context. SetupTexture records failed attempts so failed images do not retry every frame.
coverage.adoption: Project already follows a stronger split for its constrained use: one bounded decode worker, explicit admission/result acknowledgements, main-thread SDL uploads, bounded negative cache, selected-cover priority and reduced-motion completion repaint.

coverage.observed: The source explicitly says TODO: Actually make async. AsyncImageFileView.cpp constructs ManagedTexture in Draw.
coverage.adoption: Do not import this path or claim it supplies asynchronous IO for the shell.

coverage.observed: Home background media is covered by a theme-background layer whose alpha is homeBackgroundDim/100.
coverage.adoption: Reference for any future readable-overlay adjustment; existing high-contrast mode remains available. No new setting or wallpaper owner introduced.

coverage.topic: List text and short press feedback
coverage.observed: GameListCard uses a 100 ms pressed-scale animation, ContentScale.Fit for covers, theme onSurface text, and title/fileName bounded to two lines with ellipsis.
coverage.adoption: Current shell preserves real cover aspect ratio and short bounded row motion; optional two-line selected-title layout is a plausible alternative to clipped title motion.

coverage.observed: Cover sync limits work with Semaphore(3), checks emulator activity and coroutine cancellation, retries at most three times with backoff, then publishes the updated visible state.
coverage.adoption: Keep existing library/source authority and bounded decoder; do not add a second downloader/scanner or parse owner ROM containers in the renderer.

bounded_improvements.defect: RGBA in the text texture cache key caused transient alpha changes and text shadow passes to rasterize/upload identical glyph shapes repeatedly.
tests: existing deterministic static frame/no render tick IO and embedded ownership tests

host_measurement_before.scenario: 100 alpha changes, same glyph text/font/width; _text shadow and foreground

host_measurement_after.scenario: 100 alpha changes, same glyph text/font/width; _text shadow and foreground

bounded_improvements.measurement_limits: One unbenchmarked host software-renderer sample; counts are deterministic for this scenario, timings are not a target-device result.

bounded_improvements.defect: wrap("same\nsame\nsame", max_lines=2) returned two unmarked same lines because it compared paragraph text with the final paragraph value. Blank remaining paragraphs also escaped the overflow marker.

bounded_improvements.defect_or_limit: Focused game titles are still single-line ellipsized, so games sharing a long prefix may be indistinguishable on the list without another detail surface.
bounded_choices: PPSSPP-style measured, clipped selected-title reveal only; reset on focus/page changes; reduced motion keeps static ellipsis.
EmuCoreA-style selected-title block limited to two measured lines; move subtitle below actual title height so large text cannot overlap.
tests_needed: same-prefix different-suffix titles expose useful distinguishing text
large-text title/subtitle rectangles do not overlap
if motion is used: focus reset, clipping, reduced motion, static determinism and no per-frame new raster uploads

not_claimed: Full PPSSPP or EmuCoreA repository audit
A new native emulator build or installed theme activation
Hardware FPS, memory, battery or PowerVR measurements
